messages.subject: Shiny Javascript
parts:
Hi R and Shiny Family,

I am very new to R and just picked up and learning. I came across Shiny Framework and was amazed by its ease of creating websites using R by just ui.R and server.R files. However, as I tried to customize more, I find difficulties in finding tutorials and sample codes regarding using customized Javascript with ui.R version although HTML version is pretty straightforward. Would be nice if someone can create an example or tutorial of a simple application using javascript + R + Shiny Framework. 

Anyway, thanks so much for creating this framework and making us possible to post awesome charts on web.

-Aung

messages.subject: Re: Shiny Javascript
parts:
Hi Winston,

I am using pageWithSidebar layout and the basic template is as following:

# Define UI
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
 
  # Application title
  headerPanel("Hello Shiny!"),
 
  # Sidebar with a slider input
  sidebarPanel(
    sliderInput("obs","Number of observations:",min = 0,max = 1000,value = 500)
  ),
 
  # Show a plot of the generated distribution
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("distPlot")
  )
))

but I am wondering how and where I should add my custom css and js files into head section? I can use tag$head as your example shown if I use bootstrapPage but not in pageWithSidebar.

Thanks so much in advanced.

-Aung
